interpretation: For this fixture the staged resolver computes MaxOver and the tie count once per target, marks top proposals, then selects only a unique top. Work reduction is measured against the immutable v1.2 nested resolver raw capture on the same native extension/build.
limits: One authored proposal family and N through 64; no asymptotic theorem.
No proposal-set mutation after the cached result, production integration, natural tie prevalence, or learned proposal quality is measured.
The experiment compares operation counts, not uninstrumented latency or memory.
